items.description: With a mix of twisted puzzles, brain-teasing quizzes, and mind-bending mini-games, The Test of Insanity will test the very limits of your brain. Whether you’re a genius or an influencer, a billionaire or the person they just fired, whoever you are, you can be sure of one thing: The Test of Insanity will challenge your mind to the core, in ways you’ve never been challenged before. These puzzles may seem easy at a glance, but the answers may not be what you're thinking. However, solving these puzzle can also be quite satisfying. If you like puzzle games, mind twisters, or weird games, this game is for you. Featuring: ⭐ Not so traditional math problems ⭐ Weird word puzzles ⭐ Trivia of not obvious stuff ⭐ Skill tests that are incredibly difficult ⭐ Cute squirrels ⭐ And more things that make you go nuts... From math problems and word puzzles to trivia and skill tests, this puzzle game offers a diverse range of brain challenges that will keep you hooked. Inspired by the infamous Impossible Quiz, our game requires you to think outside the box and embrace the ridiculous. Question is: How far will you go before going insane? Many don’t pass level 1. items.description: Maniac: Hunt or Be Hunted is a thrilling first-person multiplayer horror experience where one player takes on the role of a ruthless maniac, while the others must cooperate, complete objectives, and fight to survive. The game is steeped in tension, where every death could be your last. The game takes place in an abandoned village surrounded by a dense forest, where all the residents mysteriously vanished, leaving behind empty homes and eerie remnants. With each passing day, the atmosphere grows darker, and the nights become unbearable. Every night is a new test of survival, as an unknown killer lurks somewhere in the shadows, ready to strike at any moment. Who will become the Maniac, and who will survive the night? The choice is yours. Players are thrown into random locations with a single goal — survive. The Maniac and survivors play as distinct characters, adding unexpected twists to every match. While the Maniac hunts and eliminates the survivors, the others must work together to outsmart, trap, or defeat the killer using scattered items and improvised tactics. A carefully designed survival system offers a range of interactive elements: search for weapons, set traps, or quietly sneak through the darkness. But the key to survival is trust — and knowing when to rely on your team. Key Features:Asymmetric multiplayer gameplay: one player (the room creator) becomes the Maniac with unique abilities, while the others must cooperate to stay alive.Deep, immersive atmosphere: realistic sound design and haunting environments constantly keep players on edge.Multiple tactical choices: survivors can pick up weapons, set traps, use distractions, or psychologically outplay one another.Special abilities for the Maniac:Highlight all survivors temporarily, allowing the Maniac to see every player’s location and plan a deadly ambush.Fear system — victims entering certain conditions (like hearing footsteps, finding corpses, or being left alone) will panic, making more noise and becoming easier to track. items.description: When an escapist child’s VR mask breaks, he begins to have intense nightmares. He must learn presence through his dream characters to face the shadowy beast he runs from.Play as TAC, a cyborg cyclops child living on the moon in the year 2300. TAC racks up points in virtual reality and explores the futuristic moonscape with a jetpack to avoid the struggles of family life. But when his routine is disrupted, he’s pulled into a journey deep within his subconscious.Enter TAC’s dreamscape—a lush crystal island inhabited by an advanced society of axolotls. Solve puzzles, challenges, and hidden mysteries to unlock mini-games and extras, helping TAC become lucid and take control of his dream - but beware, the Dream Shark is always lurking.FeaturesA Constantly Evolving Experience – Gameplay shifts between top-down exploration, platforming, isometric puzzles, faux-3D sequences, and shoot ‘em ups.Two Worlds, One Journey – Explore the tech-dominated moon and the organic dream island, each with distinct environments, characters, and challenges.Intuitive & Accessible Gameplay – Simple controls with clear guidance make it easy to jump in, though basic reading comprehension is required.A Fully Original Chiptune Soundtrack – Immerse yourself in a dynamic score that adapts to TAC’s journey.Cinematic 8-Bit Pixel Art – A richly detailed retro aesthetic, handcrafted for an authentic Game Boy experience.Made by One Developer – A passion project built entirely by Benjamin McCarthy.Do you have what it takes to face the Dream Shark? items.description: You play as Adam, a boy mourning the loss of his friend Sam. After a bitter wish for his parents to disappear, he now finds himself alone, and determined to find them.Along the way, he meets the eerie yet gentle Paper-Cut Man, who offers to help. But the deeper Adam ventures, the more reality unravels. Whispers echo. Pages bleed. Who really is this mysterious friend?This is a story about grief, guilt, and the strange ways the mind tries to protect itself.And sometimes, the sharpest cuts are the ones you don't remember making.In a world that seems off in ways he can’t explain, Adam sees a familiar face, one he isn’t sure he’s ever really known. The game has several levels with different images. All control with the mouse.
